key.name: swap-master-window
key.summary: Swap current window with master.

key.name: swap-up-window
key.summary: Swap current window with window above.

key.name: swap-down-window
key.summary: Swap current window with window below.

key.name: swap-left-window
key.summary: Swap current window with window to the left.

key.name: swap-right-window
key.summary: Swap current window with window to the right.

key.name: focus-up
key.summary: Focus window above.

key.name: focus-down
key.summary: Focus window below.

key.name: focus-left
key.summary: Focus window to the left.

key.name: focus-right
key.summary: Focus window to the right.

key.name: inner-gap
key.summary: The gap between windows in pixels.

key.name: outer-gap-horizontal
key.summary: The gap to the left and right screen edges.

key.name: outer-gap-vertical
key.summary: The gap to the top and bottom screen edges.

key.name: new-window-behavior
key.summary: Behavior for newly opened windows.
key.description: Determines if a new window is added as master or stack window.

key.name: master-ratio
key.summary: Width of the master window as a percentage of the work area.

key.name: toggle-tiling
key.summary: Toggle tiling on/off.

key.name: float-window
key.summary: Toggle float for the focused window.

key.name: toggle-monocle
key.summary: Toggle monocle mode (all windows fill the work area).

key.name: monocle-next
key.summary: Focus the next window in monocle mode.

key.name: monocle-prev
key.summary: Focus the previous window in monocle mode.

key.name: last-focused-wm-class
key.summary: WM_CLASS of the last focused window (used by preferences picker).

key.name: last-focused-app-id
key.summary: App ID of the last focused window (used by preferences picker).

key.name: exceptions
key.summary: List of window classes or app IDs excluded from tiling.
key.description: WM_CLASS values (X11) or app IDs (Wayland). Matched case-insensitively.
